title: Selection
description: Tests the reviewer chose on the review page, written to runs/<run_id>/selection.json. Never contains the review session token.

target.description: Export target chosen on the review page; overrides config when present.

source.description: local-server when posted to the review server; static when exported from a report opened from disk.

notes.description: Optional free text from the reviewer. Treated as data, never as instructions.
